lines.say: 246k stars and 29.5k forks, for a project that is still in developer preview.
This is DeepSeek Harness, an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.
Its command is dsh, and it is written almost entirely in TypeScript, at 96.2 percent.
The design rule is in the title: DeepSeek Harness, Everything is a Plugin.
To run it, install Node.js, then run npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web.
That command starts the Web UI at 127.0.0.1, port 3080, and opens it in your default browser.
To run from source, clone the repo, then run pnpm install and pnpm run build.
pnpm run dev:web builds, serves, and rebuilds the client bundles while you develop.
Coding agents get their own instructions too: the repo tells them to follow AGENTS.md.
It is still iterating rapidly, so review the safety notice before you run it.
The license is MIT, and feedback and bug reports go through GitHub Discussions.
Save this for the next time you want to try an agent harness that you can run locally.
DeepSeek Harness. Everything is a plugin.
